name: cairn-companion
description: A campaign management tool for Cairn 2e TTRPG. Quickly link to cairn items, spells, monsters, etc.. Get random suggestions and keep your PJ cheat sheets up to date

scripts.package: npm run build && rm -rf dist cairn-companion.zip && mkdir -p dist/cairn-companion && cp main.js manifest.json styles.css dist/cairn-companion/ && cp -r data dist/cairn-companion/data && cd dist && zip -r ../cairn-companion.zip cairn-companion
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: nax_hh
